how_beam: Triage filter, not a raw detector. A free AST symbol check proposes name and signature mismatches. Beam reads each library's docs and source in one packed prompt and judged 56 candidates. It rejected 0 of 32 true candidates and removed 15 of 24 false or unclear ones.
New finds. Beam added 9 true drifts the checker missed (7 new to the union), taking distinct trues from 24 to 34.
Repro author. Beam wrote every doc-literal repro script (138,138 tokens). 29 distinct bugs reproduce a real API error. 36 of 39 badges were real. 3 badges landed on non-bugs (werkzeug S38, S39, S41).

Long context, measured. Beam accepted prompts up to 947,446 tokens. Focused whole-context passes caught far-apart planted drifts that chunking missed. A single whole-prompt call alone is not a better detector than chunking or a symbol check, which is why v2 combines them.
limits: The 45-drift universe is the union of method output, so it favours those methods.
Labels were made by an AI reviewer checking file:line evidence, not by a human annotator.
Citation pass/fail is quote alignment, not correctness.
A true drift can still fail the strict repro rule (starlette T1, marshmallow T11, structlog untriaged, werkzeug input_stream).
Three false findings received a repro badge (werkzeug S38, S39, S41).
Open PR #1216 was confirmed on GitHub after results_live/upstream_status.json was written (that file only lists starlette #3746, httpx #3774, and arrow #1355).
cattrs and click have drafts in the repo; they are not listed as filed.
